turns.script: How do I undo my last commit?
turns.asr_text: How do I undo my last commit?

turns.text_generated: Hey there! Sounds like you might be in a tricky spot with your code! Don’t worry though, it’s super easy to undo your last commit. All you need is a simple Git command. Just open up your terminal and type: git reset --soft HEAD~1 if you want to keep your changes in the working directory. That’ll take you back one step, as if that last commit never happened, but keeps all your changes staged and ready for the next commit. If you want to completely discard the changes as well, you can use git reset --hard HEAD~1. Just be careful with that one, because it’ll wipe out any changes in your working directory that weren’t committed. And remember, if you’ve already pushed that commit, you might need to force push after the reset. Good luck!
